text: dsh-anchored-preset-installer（DSH Web 插件）：插件应用时把 Anchored Standard、Zero-Anchored Standard 和 Whoami Standard 三套随包的实验性 agent preset 复制到用户 preset 根目录，使它们可供会话 preset 选择。安装器只写入用户信任的 preset root；同名目录已存在时会跳过，保留已有内容。三套 preset 分别提供不同的首轮工具或提示词引导。适合想通过插件加入这些预设的 DSH 用户。代码没有配置 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-anchored-preset-installer copies three bundled presets (Anchored Standard, Zero-Anchored Standard, Whoami Standard) into DSH's user preset root. Existing directories are skipped. The presets vary first-turn tool or prompt setup. No API key or external service is configured in code.
想把几套实验性的 agent preset 安装到 DSH 的会话选择器里
有没有办法让已存在的自定义 preset 在重新安装时保持原样？
I want to add alternative first-turn agent presets to my DSH session picker.
dsh-anchored-preset-installer 的功能「安装三套 agent preset」：插件应用时将随包的三个 preset 目录复制到 DSH 用户 preset 根目录，并写入安装标记。
dsh-anchored-preset-installer 的功能「保留已有 preset」：目标目录已存在时跳过该项，不覆盖目录内容；单个 preset 的失败会被记录并继续处理其他项。

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · dsh-anchored-preset-installer：One-command delivery for the
[`dsh-anchored-standard`](https://github.com/xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard)
experimental presets. Installing this host plugin materializes the three
preset directories into the user preset root, so the session preset picker
shows **Anchored Standard (experimental)** / **Zero-Anchored Standard
(experimental)** / **Whoami Standard (experimental)** with no manual `cp`.

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:kirkchinese/dsh-anchored-preset-installer

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · without a global `dsh` binary:：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:kirkchinese/dsh-anchored-preset-installer
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness (`Ctrl+C`, then `dsh web` / `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`),
create a blank session, and pick the preset. DSH preset discovery re-reads its
roots on every list, so the presets appear as soon as the plugin row has
applied once.

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · Behavior：- Writes only into the **user-trust** preset root from
  `agentPresets.resolvedRoots` (normally `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets`).
- **Create-only**: a preset directory that already exists is left exactly
  as it is — user edits are never overwritten.
- Every failure is contained per preset and logged; the plugin row never
  fails the profile boot.
- No network requests, no telemetry, no runtime listeners — after apply the
  plugin is inert.

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · Verify：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 anchored-preset-installer
```

expects an `id: anchored-preset-installer` row (before the restart). After the
restart, the preset picker lists all three presets, and each installed
directory carries a `.installed-by-anchored-preset-installer` marker:

```sh
ls ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/
```

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · Uninstall：Removing the plugin leaves installed presets in place (they may be in use
by sessions). To remove them:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-anchored-preset-installer
rm -r ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/{anchored-standard,zero-anchored-standard,whoami-standard}
```

Only remove a preset that no session currently uses.

dsh-anchored-preset-installer README · Maintenance：`presets/` is a byte-copy of the `preset/`, `zero-anchored-standard/`, and
`whoami-standard/` directories from the upstream repository (this fork pins
the self-contained-variant + single-anchor fixes). After upstream releases
change those, sync the copies here and bump `VERSION` in `index.mjs`.
